transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. What brings you to see me today?

Hi, Doctor. Thank you for seeing me. I, uh, I hope I'm sitting in the right place. 

I guess what brings me in is... well, it's probably nothing major, I don't want to be a bother or anything, but sometimes my talking gets a little bit mixed up. It's a bit embarrassing to admit. I'll just be trying to explain something, like, you know, about the keys, and then the jail, and then the prayer rug, and then the chess pieces... and people just tell me they cannot follow what I am saying. 

I feel real bad about it when it happens, because I don't mean to confuse anybody. I'm trying really hard to be clear for you today, though. Am I explaining that okay so far?
Have you ever heard voices or other sounds when no one else was around?

Oh, um... well... I don't want you to think badly of me, or think I'm making things up. It's probably just the old building where I clean, you know? The pipes can make funny noises. 

But, uh... sometimes... I do hear this man's voice. It usually comes from the vents, or when I'm in the mop closet getting my supplies. He'll say my name, or... well, he tells me that I ruined everything. And I swear, Doctor, it sounds just as real as someone standing right beside me. 

I try really hard to just ignore it and do my job, though. I know it's probably just my mind playing tricks on me. I hope that doesn't make me sound too strange... did I explain that okay?
Have you been feeling down, sad, or depressed lately?

Well... I try really hard to keep my spirits up, I promise I do. I don't want to be a complainer or bring anyone down. 

But, um... I guess I shouldn't hide it from you. I'm a little ashamed to admit it, because I know I should just be grateful, but... on my bad days, sometimes right after my morning prayer, I just end up sitting there on the edge of the bed. I get this feeling like I'm just... heavy. And empty inside. It gets to feeling like there's no point in even cleaning myself up or going outside at all. 

I always try to push past it, though, because I don't want to be lazy or miss my shifts at the building. I hope it's alright that I feel that way sometimes... am I giving you the right kind of answers, Doctor?
Do you hear this man's voice even during times when you are not feeling down or depressed?

Oh, um... well, I don't want to make a big deal out of it, and I really hope you don't think I'm completely losing my mind or anything. 

But, yes... even when I'm not feeling so heavy and sad, and even when I'm not feeling... well, sometimes I get real energetic, too... but even during the calm weeks, when I'm just feeling normal, the voice is still there. 

There was a stretch recently, maybe for a little over two weeks, where my mood was just fine. I was going to work, doing my job, not too high, not too low. But I still heard the man in the vents telling me things. And... well, I also still felt like the people working in the offices were leaving little signs or signals about me when I went in to empty their trash. 

I know it sounds bad, and I really try not to let it bother me or get in the way of my cleaning. I just try to keep my head down. Does that make sense, Doctor? I hope I'm not making things too complicated.
